entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnet test does not isolate/consume cli parameters correctly #56338
  • CA1508 throws NullReferenceException (AD0001) for a comparison in an attribute on a top-level type or the assembly #56337
  • `dotnet new search` throws RevocationStatusUnknown when using TLS inspection proxy (macOS) #56334
  • NativeAOT Cross-Compilation Support for macOS and Windows #56333
  • Plumb cancellationtokens through all CLI commands for consistent behavior #56331

Closed

  • CA2263 fix incorrectly drops all parameters after 'type' when 'params' follows #53189
  • False positive for CA2263 with codefix changing code functionality. #52654
    11.0.1xx

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix workload manifest overlay #56349
    Servicing-consider, Branch Lockdown
  • Retarget SDK sources to net12.0 without updating stage zero #56348
  • Add NativeAOT size and retention explorer #56347
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 3079489 #56346
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Prevent CA2263 from changing generic System.Type values #56343
    backport
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Fix spurious CA1416 warnings in guard members and in nameof #56341
    Servicing-approved, backport
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Prevent CA2025 analyzer crash for direct field arguments #56340
    Servicing-consider, backport
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Fix CA1517 false positive for tuple assignments #56339
    Servicing-consider, backport
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56336
  • Bump the github-actions group with 2 updates #56335
    dependencies, github_actions
  • Plumb CancellationToken through all CLI commands for consistent Ctrl+C/SIGTERM behavior #56332

Merged

  • Simplify CA1517 usage checks and expand regression coverage #56342
  • Improve container registry authentication consistency #56344
    Area-Containers
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Restore generated assets in Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers packages #56309
    Servicing-approved, backport
  • Validate content type and origin in WASM POST requests #56307
    Area-Watch
  • Containers: Add digest validation for manifests and image configuration #56345
    Servicing-approved, Area-Containers, 11.0-rc2
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 3076847 #56178
    sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • [release/11.0.1xx] fix(analyzers): exclude operators from CA1822 false positive #55908
    Servicing-approved, backport, 11.0-rc2
  • Prevent CA2263 from changing generic System.Type values #55900
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Performance improvements in SymbolNamesWithValueOption<T> #54120
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers

  • [release/10.0.1xx] Restore generated assets in Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers packages #56310
    Servicing-consider, backport
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56329

    arch-wasm, Area-AspNetCore
